lines.text: Many learners say: I am interested to music.
Better: I am interested in music.
Say interested in, not interested to.
In! I am interested in art.

data.why: Say interested in, not interested to.

native.tip: 「〜に興味がある」は interested in。to ではなく in を使います。
native.caption: “I am interested to music.”と言っていませんか？😅 日本語の「に」につられて to を使いがちです。“I am interested in music.” が自然な言い方です。Amaの声をまねして練習しよう！Lexkiteアプリでもっと練習できます。
native.comment: 答え：“in”。“I am interested in music.” を声に出して言ってみよう。無料クイズで練習：{link}

en.tip: Say interested in. Do not use to.
en.caption: Do you say this? “I am interested to music.” 😅 The Japanese word に makes us say to, but English uses in. The natural way is “I am interested in music.” Listen to Ama and repeat! Practice more in the Lexkite app.
